_about: DingoGo app words. English (en) is the default and the source. Arrernte (aer, Eastern/Central Arrernte as spoken in Mparntwe) and Kriol (rop) entries are DRAFTS: they must be checked and approved by Arrernte and Kriol speakers before they are treated as correct. Anything left empty falls back to English. To review: run `npm run i18n:review` for a spreadsheet, fill in reviewed_by / reviewed_on and change status to reviewed. Do not machine-translate.

aer.note: Common greeting in Mparntwe Arrernte. Check spelling and use with Arrernte speakers.

rop.note: Unconfirmed. Needs a Kriol speaker to check, or replace.

acknowledgement.en: DingoGo operates on Arrernte Country. We acknowledge the Arrernte people, the Traditional Owners of Mparntwe (Alice Springs), and pay our respects to Elders past and present.

acknowledgement_short.en: On Arrernte Country. We pay our respects to Elders past and present.
